ACTION: Read `~/.claude/skills/subagent-driven-development/references/fix-loop.md`. It decides who fixes this round (resumed implementer or fresh agent), how the re-review runs, and when to adjudicate.

ACTION: Dispatch a fix subagent on `haiku`, or resume the Task 3 implementer if fix-loop.md says so. The prompt gives F1 verbatim and asks for four things: change `docs/sync.md:12` from `--dry_run` to `--dry-run`, confirm no other `--dry_run` remains in `docs/`, run the task's existing checks, and commit. This is a one-line doc fix, so the cheapest tier can do it in one pass.

ACTION: Run `scripts/review-package` with the plan file, the base commit and the new HEAD. Then dispatch the scoped re-review from `re-review-prompt.md` on `sonnet`, which is the review floor. The prompt names the diff file path and F1, and asks for an ADDRESSED or NOT ADDRESSED verdict per finding.

ACTION: If the re-review reports F1 addressed and no new Critical or Important finding, append `Task 3: complete (commits <base7>..<head7>, review clean)` to `.sdd/14-buoy-sync/progress.md`. Then dispatch Task 4.

Task 3 is not done yet. The reviewer found one Important issue. `docs/sync.md:12` names the flag `--dry_run`, but the code, the help text and the tests all use `--dry-run`. I am sending a fix agent to correct it, then a scoped re-review. After that, I move to the next task.

`★ Insight ─────────────────────────────────────`
No code or test reads `docs/sync.md`. The wrong flag name therefore passes every test, and only the reviewer's check against the spec found it.
A user who copies the command from the doc gets an "unrecognized arguments" error from the CLI. This is why the review blocks the task even though the fix is one line.
`─────────────────────────────────────────────────`
